text:
## [SECTION 2: Jungle Ki Khamoshi]

Jaise-jaise hamari gaadi Zone 4 ki taraf badhti gayi, jungle ka naksha aur mahol poori tarah se badal gaya. Charon taraf ghane ped ek deewar jaisa mahol bana rahe the jo bahar ki duniya ko bilkul alag kar dete the. Baarish ke baad mitti ki wo bhari aur meethi mehak ab hawa mein zyada shiddat se mehsoos ho rahi thi. Aisa lag raha tha jaise zameen kuch kehna chahti ho. Hamari gaadi ke pahiya jab geeli pattiyon par chalte, toh unse nikalne wali aawaz bhi kisi gehri khamoshi mein dabi rehti thi. Is ilake mein hamari raftar kaafi dheemi thi aur hawa ek jagah ruk kar sirf dhire se hil rahi thi. Vikram ne apna walkie-talkie uthaya aur uske signal ko check karne ki koshish ki, par wahan sirf ek bhari shor yaani static sunai de raha tha. Maine unse pucha ki kya humein base station se koi khabar mil rahi hai? Unhone bas ek gehri saans li aur apna sar hilaya. Vikram ne thodi gambhirta se kaha, "Is zone mein signal aksar mar jaate hain, yahan se aage hum sirf apne upar nirbhar rahenge." Humne apni raftar nahi badhayi balki savdhani se aage badhte rahe.

Humne gaadi ek jagah roki aur kuch der ke liye wahan ruk kar us mausam ko mehsoos kiya jo kaafi bhari tha. Mausam ki nami itni zyada thi ki saans lete waqt bhi gale mein kuch rukavat jaisa lag raha tha. Vikram ne mujhe dekha aur phir unhone ek khaas raste ki taraf ishara kiya jise wo echo zone kehte the. Unhone bataya ki is valley mein kabhi-kabhi purani aawazein ya kisi janwar ki cheekh ek hi jagah par bar-bar goonjti rehti hain. "Yahan ki hawaein kuch cheezon ko pakad leti hain aur unhe baar-bar repeat karti hain," unhone warn kiya jo sunkar mujhe thoda ajeeb laga. Maine tab unki baat ko sirf ek anubhav maana, lekin dil mein ek halki si bechaini ka ehsaas hone laga tha. Humne gaadi phir se chalu ki aur us raste par nikal pade jo lagbhag mitti ke dheron aur purani jhadion se dhaka hua tha. Har mod par mujhe aisa lag raha tha jaise hum kisi anjaan khatre ki taraf badh rahe hain. Humari himmat bhi kam ho rahi thi lekin kaam zaroor karna tha.

Jaise-jaise hum jungle ke beech mein pahunche, mujhe aisa mehsoos hone laga jaise koi humein bahut kareeb se dekh raha hai. Yeh kisi sher ya kisi anya janwar ki nazron jaisa nahi tha; ye kuch zyada hi shant aur bhari tha. Har kadh par lagta tha jaise koi jhaadiyon ke peeche chhupa ho, jo hamari har harkat ko bade dhyan se track kar raha ho. Mere peeche se aane wali hawaon mein ek thandak thi jo haddiyon tak mehsoos hoti rahi. Vikram bhi thode alert nazar aaye aur unhone apni gun ki grip ko thoda zyada mazboot pakad liya tha. Humne kuch nahi kaha, par hum dono ko pata tha ki hum is bade jungle mein akele nahi hain. Is sannate mein har choti si aawaz, jaise kisi sukhe patte ka girna ya door kahin ek pathar ka takrana, bahut zyada daravani lagti thi. Koi bhi dhwani hata sa lag rahi thi jo mahol ko aur bhari bana rahi thi. Har pal darr ka ehsaas badhta ja raha tha.

Jaise-jaise shaam hone lagi, jungle ka rang badalne laga aur sab kuch thoda dhundhla dikhne laga tha. Suraj ki roshni kam hoti ja rahi thi aur pedon ki parchhaiyan lambi hokar zameen par phail rahi thi. Tabhi humne pehli baar us ajeeb shor ko suna, jo ek dum se mere kaano mein goonj gaya. Yeh kisi janwar ki awaaz nahi thi, balki ek thud ya kisi lakdi ke girne ki aawaz thi jo har dus second par bilkul ek jahan repeat ho rahi thi. Maine Vikram ki taraf dekha aur unka chehra bhi us aawaz ki taraf mud gaya tha. "Yeh kya hai?" maine dheere se pucha, meri awaaz hawa mein thodi kaanp gayi thi. Unhone koi jawab nahi diya, bas us disha mein dekhte rahe jahan se wo aawaz aa rahi thi. Woh aawaz bilkul ek machine ki tarah repeat ho rahi thi, jaise kuch phans gaya ho aur baar-baar ek hi raftar par takra raha ho. Maine unhe dekha toh unka chehra bilkul safed pad gaya tha.

Raat ka andhera dheere-dheere neeche utar raha tha aur jungle ab pehle se kahin zyada bhari mehsoos hone laga tha. Humne gaadi ki lights tez kar di, lekin unki roshni bhi un ghane pedon ke beech bahut kam door tak ja pa rahi thi. Har baar jab wo aawaz hoti, mere dil ki dhadkan thodi badh jati aur paseene ki ek boond meri peeth par aa jati. Yeh sirf ek aawaz nahi thi; yeh kisi cheez ka intezar karne jaisa lag raha tha jo kahin chhupi hui thi. Humne tay kiya ki humein is jagah se nikalna hai, lekin rasta jaise dhundla hota ja raha tha aur pedon ke beech ka antar nazar nahi aa raha tha. Shaam ki us thandak mein ab dar shuru ho raha tha, ek aisa darr jo sirf jungle ke in gehre hisson mein hi paya jata hai. Har pal lag raha tha jaise koi cheez humein rokne aayegi. Humne gaadi ki raftar badhayi par rasta aur bhi mushkil hota ja raha tha. Mere dil mein bas ek hi sawal tha, kya hum yahan se bahar nikal payenge? Raat ki gehrai ne hamare darr ko aur zyada badha diya tha.
summary: The officers enter the "No-Go Zone," experiencing a loss of communication and an eerie sense of being watched, before hearing a strange, rhythmic sound that repeats every ten seconds as dusk falls.
